Elementals of the [Plane of Earth](/Planes.aspx?ID=5) can be fiercely territorial. Some more solitary elementals protect their lairs on their own, but occasionally others band together to defend larger regions that serve as shared turf. Notable among these alliances are avalanche legions, who patrol the perimeter of these shared territories, driving off intruders who dare to trespass upon their home ground. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 28 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 26 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 23 [Avalanche Legion](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2622) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 102 **Perception** +21; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet **Languages** [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +23 **Str** +5 **Dex** +0 **Con** +4 **Int** -2 **Wis** +1 **Cha** +0 **Earthbound** When not touching solid ground, the avalanche legion is [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35). --- **AC** 31 **Fort** +24 **Ref** +20 **Will** +21 **HP** 240 (16 squares) **Immunities** bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) **Weaknesses** area damage 15, [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage 8 **[Troop Defenses](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=44)** --- **Speed** 30 feet, burrow 25 feet; earth glide, troop movement **[Form Up](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=43)** **Earth Glide** The avalanche legion can [Burrow](/Actions.aspx?ID=93) through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the legion moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing. **Pummeling Boulders** **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The avalanche legion unleashes an onslaught of blows against each enemy within 5 feet (DC 28 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). The damage depends on the number of actions.
2d8 bludgeoning damage
3d8+8 bludgeoning damage
4d8+11 bludgeoning damage **Spinning Stones** The avalanche legion spins in place, kicking up a barrage of stones. Each creature in a 10-foot burst within 30 feet of the troop takes 2d12+10 bludgeoning damage (DC 28 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). When the troop is reduced to 8 or fewer squares, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst. **Trample into the Earth** The avalanche legion speeds forward, running over creatures with their stone bodies and knocking them down. As [Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=39); Gargantuan or smaller, 2d8 bludgeoning damage, DC 28. A creature that critically fails its save is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31). **Troop Movement** Whenever the avalanche legion Strides or Burrows, it first Forms Up as a free action to condense into a 20-foot-by-20-foot area (minus any missing squares), then moves up to its respective Speed. This works just like a Gargantuan creature moving; for instance, if any square of the legion enters difficult terrain, the extra movement cost applies to all the elementals.
Familial Instincts Although elementals don't reproduce like typical creatures, [living landslide](/Monsters.aspx?ID=183) sometimes develop bonds with smaller or weaker earth elementals, such as [earth wisps](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1143), [living boulders](/Monsters.aspx?ID=650), and [sod hounds](/Monsters.aspx?ID=182). When several of these smaller elementals are gathered in one place, living landslides who cared for the creatures often continue to watch over their wards. Avalanche legions sometimes form from these gatherings, as multiple living landslides join forces to protect the smaller elementals.
